desc:
UPDATE: MOBILE CONTROLS NOW ADDED! Please report any issues you run into.

🏸 Welcome to Untitled Badminton Game! Step onto the court, build a rally, and outplay your opponent in a skill-based badminton game where you aim and time every shot.

Play singles or doubles, challenge a bot, and learn the game with a guided tutorial. Master smashes, drops, clears, drives, and net shots. Matches go to 21 points; win by 2.

MNK CONTROLS:
WASD — Move
Space — Jump
Shift — Sprint
Ctrl — Mouse lock
Right Click — Forehand
Left Click — Backhand
Hold and release both mouse buttons — Overhead
G — Serve
Q — Dive
H — Show controls
P — Settings  
B — Display In-Match Stats

Hold a swing to charge it, then release to hit. Aim with your camera to control the shot. Rebind controls in Settings.
